metaTitle: The Fatty Crab Case Study: 46M+ Views | Button Up Media
metaDescription: How Button Up Media grew The Fatty Crab in Doral to 46M+ video views and 350K+ followers across Instagram, Facebook and TikTok with short video.
ldHeadline: The Fatty Crab: 46M+ social video views for a Doral seafood boil restaurant
answer: We run social media for The Fatty Crab, a Cajun seafood boil spot in Doral. Short videos built around the food reached 46M+ views on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.

hero.alt: A short video Button Up Media made for The Fatty Crab: a guest digging into a seafood boil

card.alt: A guest eating crab at The Fatty Crab
card.label: video views

metrics.label: Video views
metrics.meaning: Instagram Reels 34.3M, Facebook 9.1M and TikTok 2.7M, measured in Sprout Social from January 2022 to November 2026.

metrics.label: Followers
metrics.meaning: Facebook 182K, Instagram 155K and TikTok 16K. A local audience The Fatty Crab can reach for free every time it posts.

metrics.label: Instagram engagement rate
metrics.meaning: How often people who see a post like, comment or share it. Across all three platforms it is 5.5%.

paragraphs: The feed was mostly static posts on an inconsistent schedule.
A Cajun seafood boil is made for video, and the occasional photo was not keeping The Fatty Crab top of mind.

items.title: Give every post a job
items.bodyHtml: Four content pillars: the food, the experience, the people and the culture.

items.title: Build video templates
items.bodyHtml: Reusable short-form formats, so shooting and editing stay fast.

items.title: Post when the audience is online
items.bodyHtml: A schedule tuned to when their followers actually scroll, on Instagram and Facebook.

items.title: Point every caption at a visit
items.bodyHtml: Hooks, captions and calls to action aimed at one thing: reservations and visits.

items.title: Sell dinner at dinnertime
items.bodyHtml: One organic Reel with pack-out shots and an “Order on Uber Eats” call to action, posted at peak delivery hours. It drove Uber Eats orders with no paid budget behind it.

items.title: Team up with a local creator
items.bodyHtml: From July 2023 to March 2024 we partnered with a food creator with a strong Miami and South Florida following. We planned the videos together around hero dishes, the room and the staff, posted at peak discovery times on Instagram and TikTok, and backed them up with reposts, story features and community management.

points: One of our Fatty Crab Reels, built on a scroll-stop hook, passed 1.2M views on its own.
The influencer campaign brought a wave of new followers, and more guests mentioned the creator's videos when they came in.
